answer: Newcomers earn entry by curating one island archive shelf for a full season: they catalogue shale specimens, cross-check each entry against tundra field notes held by two independent collectors, and publish the corrected catalogue for a rotating archivist panel to audit within seven days. A duplicate catalogue, a copied entry, or a mismatch with the field notes voids the shelf, revokes every linked identity, and bars its sponsor for a season. Forging a thousand shelves means forging a thousand seasons of checked fieldwork, while one honest curator needs only one.
